transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As we get started, I want to frame what we're here to accomplish. The architecture proposal recommends moving the internal developer portal from its current mix of password-based access and long-lived service tokens to OpenID Connect for authentication. I have the authority to approve this architecture and its operating controls, but per our architecture review checklist, I need final validation of authentication compatibility and operating controls before I can sign off. So I'd like to hear from each of you on those two areas -- what do we know about compatibility with existing systems, and what operating controls are being proposed?

transcript.text: I need to share something important before we go further. I haven't updated the architecture proposal yet because the inventory was only confirmed this morning, but this directly affects both authentication compatibility and the operating controls Morgan needs to validate.
